id.description: The registration id. Write it into the PRIVATE JWK as `kid` before saving the file (RN-475): it is the only link between the key on disk and the public half on the server, and every step downstream only passes it along.

userId.description: The owner the api RESOLVED — the installation's sole user. The caller does not choose it and does not send it; this field is here so the installer can check it against the account it just created rather than assume.

replacedKeyIds.description: Ids of the MACHINE keys this one REPLACED — revoked in the same transaction. Empty is the normal case (a fresh installation). Non-empty means a local agent still holding one of them stops getting tickets, and the installer should say so instead of letting it be discovered. Project keys (ADR 0118) are never touched.

400.description: The JWK is not a PUBLIC Ed25519 key — malformed JSON, wrong `kty`/`crv`, missing `x`, or carrying `d` (that is the private half, and it is refused by name rather than stored).

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

409.description: The installation has no user, or more than one. Nothing was written. This route belongs to the moment of installation and goes quiet for good once the installation has a team.
